sample.question:
The synchronized front, right, and top panels show labeled beacons in a 5x5x5 coordinate cube. Coordinates are (x,y,z), each from 0 to 4. Rotation Z+ maps (x,y,z) to (4-y,x,z); rotation X+ maps it to (x,4-z,y).
Which beacon has the greatest z-coordinate?
A. D
B. E
C. A
D. B
E. C
sample.analysis: Read height from the three views. Beacon E is at (1, 1, 4) and has z=4, greater than every other beacon. The answer is B.
